numbering: Original Japanese broadcast numbering, episodes 1-112 counted continuously (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Spirit Detective
arcs.summary: Delinquent Yusuke Urameshi dies saving a child and is brought back to life as a Spirit Detective for the afterlife.
events: Yusuke earns his revival through a test set by Koenma.
He recovers three stolen treasures, first meeting Kurama and Hiei.
Yusuke trains under Genkai and defeats the technique thief Rando.

arcs.name: Saint Beasts
arcs.summary: Yusuke is sent to Maze Castle in the Demon World border to stop four beasts threatening the human world with insects.
events: Kuwabara, Kurama and Hiei join Yusuke inside Maze Castle.
Each of the Four Saint Beasts is defeated in turn.
Yusuke defeats Suzaku, the leader, by pouring everything into his Spirit Gun.

arcs.name: Rescue of Yukina
arcs.summary: The team is sent to free an ice maiden held captive by a cruel businessman.
events: Yusuke and Kuwabara confront Tarukane's hired guards, the Toguro brothers.
Yusuke defeats the younger Toguro and Yukina is freed.
Hiei is revealed to be watching over Yukina as her secret brother.

arcs.name: Dark Tournament
arcs.summary: The Toguro brothers force Team Urameshi into the Dark Tournament, a demon fighting contest on a remote island.
events: Team Urameshi fights its way through the bracket against demon teams.
Genkai is killed by the younger Toguro.
Yusuke defeats the younger Toguro in the final and the team wins.

arcs.name: Chapter Black
arcs.summary: Psychics with strange territorial powers appear in Yusuke's town, and a former Spirit Detective plots to open a tunnel to the Demon World.
events: Kuwabara is kidnapped and the team learns of Shinobu Sensui's plan.
Sensui shows the Chapter Black tape exposing Spirit World's crimes.
Yusuke is killed by Sensui and revived as a demon descendant of Raizen.
Raizen's power takes over Yusuke's body and defeats Sensui.

arcs.name: Three Kings
arcs.summary: Yusuke, Kurama and Hiei are each summoned to the Demon World by one of its three rival kings.
events: Yusuke serves the starving Raizen, while Hiei joins Mukuro and Kurama aids Yomi.
Raizen dies and Yusuke proposes a tournament to decide the Demon World's ruler.
The Demon World tournament is held and Yusuke returns home to Keiko.

filler.note: Almost all episodes adapt the manga; the four filler episodes are anime-original matches during the Demon World tournament (Anime Filler Guide).
